title: ADR-016: Information architecture — empty/loading/error states, async state hook, keyboard help overlay, progressive disclosure

done: cmdk installed — used in ADR-015 palette

steps.description: Wire empty states into primary surfaces. SpecInput empty editor: EmptyState with action buttons (Drop spec / Paste URL / Pick provider). DiffResults empty: two variants — 'No diff computed yet' (run Diff action) vs 'Specs are identical' (checkmark icon, t-meta hint). MigrationGuide empty: 'Compute a diff to generate migration steps'. ProviderSidebar empty: 'Add a provider in Settings'.
steps.done_condition: every primary surface renders a meaningful EmptyState instead of blank markup when data is absent

steps.description: Create src/hooks/use-async-state.js. Exposes { status, data, error, run } where status cycles idle → loading → success/error. Replaces try/catch+setState boilerplate. Not for network (use react-query for that) — only for parse/diff/build compute steps.
steps.done_condition: hook exported; unit-tested with a sync success + sync failure case

steps.description: Adopt react-query for spec URL fetch inside SpecInput.jsx (useQuery with enabled flag triggered on submit). Show LoadingState while pending, ErrorState on failure with a Retry action that calls refetch. Respect Content-Length for determinate progress when available; else indeterminate skeleton.
steps.done_condition: spec URL fetch shows loading skeleton then content; failure shows ErrorState with functional Retry

steps.description: Apply use-async-state to diff computation in DiffViewer.jsx. If compute exceeds 100ms, render a diff-row skeleton using shadcn Skeleton primitives. On completion, crossfade (duration-base) to real results.
steps.done_condition: large spec pairs show skeleton; small specs render synchronously without flash

steps.description: Build src/components/help/KeyboardHelp.jsx — shadcn Dialog listing all shortcuts grouped (Navigation, Diff, Editor, Settings). Registered via global '?' key listener in App.jsx. Each shortcut row uses .t-meta label + kbd chrome.
steps.done_condition: '?' opens help dialog; contents match actual registered shortcuts; Esc closes

steps.description: Surface shortcuts in-context: every action button that has a keyboard shortcut displays it inside its shadcn Tooltip (e.g. Tooltip text 'Run diff  ⌘↵'). Build a small shortcuts registry (src/lib/shortcuts.js) that both the help dialog and the Tooltip layer read from.
steps.done_condition: shortcut-bearing buttons show the shortcut in their tooltip; registry is single source

steps.description: Progressive disclosure on DiffResults: group rows by added/removed/modified/renamed. Each group header shows count + chevron; starts collapsed when total rows > 50, expanded otherwise. Uses shadcn Accordion.
steps.done_condition: large diffs open to compact grouped view; small diffs render expanded as before

steps.description: Progressive disclosure on MigrationGuide: show Timeline by default, 'View checklist' button expands full task list (Collapsible). Rename detection results fold under a 'Renames (N)' pill that expands on click.
steps.done_condition: guide default view is timeline only; checklist opens on demand; rename pill expands

steps.description: Run `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, `hex analyze .`. No domain/port/usecase touched — only primary adapter and hooks.
